title: Rally home
goal: Add a rally point, fly away, and see Return to launch go to the rally point instead of home.

steps.text: On the plan's Rally tab, add a rally point in the ring, then upload the plan.
steps.hint: Rally: click inside the ring. Upload sends the rally points with the mission.

steps.text: Fly out to the far ring, then press Return to launch.
steps.hint: Use Go to on the far ring.

steps.text: Watch it go to the rally point, nearer than home, and land there.

fails.says: Failed. Landed {distance:rally-spot} m from the rally point.

passed: Passed. Landed {distance:rally-spot} m from the rally point.
